_comment: ADR 0044 — default collision layer name → bit mapping. Godot physics uses 32-bit layer masks; this file gives them human names. Each entity's physics.collision_layer / collision_mask declares the layer NAMES it lives on and reacts to; the engine translates to bit masks at body creation. Per-game extension: a game can ship its own data/<game>/physics_layers.json with additional categories. The engine merges them on top of these defaults.
_authoring_note: Layer indices ARE the Godot collision layer bits (1..32). The engine reads physics.collision_layer:['wall'] and sets body's collision_layer to bit 2. physics.collision_mask:['player','enemy'] gets bit 5 + bit 7 set. Per-game extensions append new names at unused bit slots (17..32 reserved for game-specific). Default `mask: 'all'` means 0xFFFFFFFF (collides with everything).
